reviews.title: Ads trashed this app
reviews.text: As soon as you open this app there’s a minute long ad commercial.

reviews.title: Ads Galore
reviews.text: This app has started throwing ads every 5 seconds, unless you go ad-free. It isn’t usable.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Not happy about the constant ad banner(I despise ads in any capacity!!!) and after I reinstalled the app(had it, didn’t use for long enough it went away), the nagware banner is literally the first thing put in view it both blocks easy access to seeing at a glance without moving it the times for the weather predictions today and everything else. I NEVER buy apps and never will and like I said I hate ads with a burning passion. I get you need to make money but find another way without showing ads or charging for the app. The only reason I ever downloaded this app was because the preloaded weather app refused to work. I’m gonna check if it works now and if it does I’m dropping you. Edit: how DARE you have the gall to have a “premium” paid subscription

reviews.title: Ads - no weather
reviews.text: I never write negative reviews. This app is terrible. It gives you ads for mobile games and you can’t even view the weather. There’s no way of getting out of the ad it just sits there.
